decision_blocked_until: Repository evidence does not identify the active provider account or establish external guarantees.
missing_proof: Provider/model names and versions, account privacy settings, authoritative retention, training-use, residency, and deletion terms, plus a dated redacted account receipt. Preserved claim: Provider privacy, retention, training use, data residency, and deletion guarantees are provider-dependent and unverified.
recommended_acquisition_method: Bind the exact configured provider account and model version; capture settings and governing-term digests without secrets.
reopening_trigger: Provider/model configuration, account settings, terms, region, retention, or deletion guarantees change.

decision_blocked_until: No exact model pair or completed replacement-regression run is established.
missing_proof: Current and replacement provider/model versions, a frozen equivalence benchmark, and independently verified regression results. Preserved claim: Provider/model replacement equivalence and regression protection have not been tested.
recommended_acquisition_method: Run both exact versions against frozen inputs and thresholds and retain a digest-bound comparison receipt.
reopening_trigger: Either model, benchmark, threshold, API, or result changes.

decision_blocked_until: Current dependency records identify services but do not prove the complete reviewed set.
missing_proof: A verified legal, terms, license, and privacy review covering AI providers, Cloudflare, GitHub, Apple Shortcuts and Notes, and dependencies is incomplete. Preserved claim: No legal/terms/license/privacy-policy review exists for AI providers, Cloudflare, GitHub, Apple Shortcuts/Notes, or dependencies.
recommended_acquisition_method: Bind the exact services and versions, review their current governing terms and licenses, record privacy and data obligations, and approve a dated digest-bound receipt.
reopening_trigger: A service, dependency, license, term, privacy policy, account region, or review receipt changes.

decision_blocked_until: Physical persistence behavior cannot be proven from repository source.
missing_proof: A supported iOS/Safari/device matrix and executed receipts for eviction, private browsing, low-storage pressure, and OS-upgrade persistence. Preserved claim: Safari storage eviction, private browsing, low-storage, and OS-upgrade persistence are not proven.
recommended_acquisition_method: Install on each supported physical configuration, seed non-secret state, run each condition, and record before/after digests.
reopening_trigger: Supported devices, OS/browser versions, storage code, or results change.

decision_blocked_until: Current platform references do not establish a complete supported and tested matrix.
missing_proof: An approved support matrix naming supported iOS versions, Safari or WebKit versions, and iPhone or iPad device classes, with compatibility receipts, is incomplete. Preserved claim: No supported iOS/Safari/device matrix is defined.
recommended_acquisition_method: Freeze the supported matrix, execute the minimum install, storage, update, offline, and recovery checks on each configuration, and retain dated receipts.
reopening_trigger: The supported device list, iOS version, Safari or WebKit version, runtime behavior, or compatibility result changes.

decision_blocked_until: Repository source shows intentions, not actual iOS suspension behavior.
missing_proof: A bounded background-execution contract and suspension/resume tests on every supported iOS/Safari Home Screen configuration. Preserved claim: Background execution expectations conflict with iOS web-app suspension limits unless bounded.
recommended_acquisition_method: Measure suspend, timer throttling, network interruption, resume, and stale-state recovery against declared limits.
reopening_trigger: Background expectations, WebKit behavior, supported matrix, or runtime implementation changes.

decision_blocked_until: Provider updates and competitor freshness are external changing state.
missing_proof: Bound provider/model and competitor versions, monitoring cadence, drift/freshness checks, claim-expiry rules, and dated monitoring receipts. Preserved claim: Model drift, provider updates, competitor freshness, and claim expiry are not operationally monitored.
recommended_acquisition_method: Record exact versions and claim dates, schedule rechecks, run drift/freshness comparisons, and expire stale claims.
reopening_trigger: Versions, benchmark, cadence, thresholds, or claim dates change.

decision_blocked_until: No active replacement executor or completed self-improvement run is established.
missing_proof: Exact provider/model configuration and executable self-improvement or replacement path, plus a bounded independently verified run. Preserved claim: Self-improvement and model replacement are only designed.
recommended_acquisition_method: Bind the effective route and versions, run a non-promoting sandbox trial, verify authority limits, and retain rollback proof.
reopening_trigger: Executor, provider/model, authority rule, sandbox result, or rollback mechanism changes.
